a1.criterion: uv lock succeeds and the resolved torch is a +cu128 or +cu129 build

attempts.cause: uv index strategy is first-match: it found the torch NAME on PyPI and never looked at the pytorch index named one line above
the previous attempt left a valid empty venv behind; fixed with --allow-existing rather than by deleting it
probe had no if __name__ == '__main__' guard, and vLLM v1 spawns its engine core, which re-imports the main module
flashinfer JIT-compiles its sampling kernel at first use and found no CUDA toolkit; the only nvcc in the venv is a CUDA 13 one

blocked.note: A3, A4 and A5 are implemented, staged and unit-checked, and have not run. What stops them is cluster capacity, and the two measurements below are why no amount of resizing or waiting fixes it inside the window.

capacity.reason: A node with no step can still be full. Session teardown kills the srun client while the compute processes keep running, so the step disappears from squeue and the memory stays allocated.

staging.finding: /home is at its hard quota (101G of 101G)
staging.consequence: conda create --clone fails even when the destination is node-local, because it unpacks into $CONDA_ROOT/pkgs on /home
staging.misleading_symptom: reported as InvalidArchiveError, 'you probably need to delete and re-download', which points at a corrupt package rather than at a full filesystem

staging.finding: a plain cp -a of a conda env works
staging.consequence: 19 GB in 13.5 min; the copy imports torch 2.11.0+cu129, transformer_engine 2.16.0, flash_attn 2.8.3, megatron-core 0.16.0rc0, ray 2.58.0 with sys.prefix resolved to the new location

staging.finding: --no-build applied to a whole requirement line is all-or-nothing
staging.consequence: func-timeout ships an sdist and no wheel, so the line became unsatisfiable and installed none of its packages
staging.misleading_symptom: surfaces much later as ModuleNotFoundError: jaxtyping from inside skyrl.train.trainer

staging.finding: causal-conv1d is not on the FSDP gate's path
staging.consequence: skyrl.train, RayPPOTrainer and FullyAsyncRayPPOTrainer all import without it; it is for Mamba-family models and A5 runs a plain transformer
staging.misleading_symptom: SkyRL's [fsdp] extra lists it, which suggests the only compile in phase A is unavoidable
